Name: Stardew Valley Armaments
Author: Deridor
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/sx1EA1t.png[/img]
This mod adds 44 new weapons under 6 new archetypes, expanding the vanilla 4 weapon styles to a total of 10.

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/eDXzfO0.png[/img]
[/b]
[list]
[*][color=lightblue][b]Rapiers:[/b][/color]﻿ Fast, stabbing swords with a high crit chance. Their special attack is an invincible dash forward followed by a trio of quick stabs.
[*][color=red][b]Battleaxes:[/b][/color] Heavy hitting, weaponized axes. Their special attack is a spinning slash!
[*][color=grey][b]Maces:[/b][/color] Smaller clubs with greater attack speed. Their special attack is a combo, 2 quick smacks followed by a slam.
[*][color=darkblue][b]Staves:[/b][/color] Projectile weapons that do minimal melee damage. Their special attack is a projectile spell.
[*][color=orange][b]Katanas:[/b][/color] Sharp, artisan blades meant for slashing. Their special attack is a slash through the enemy followed by a slash at their back.
[*][color=gold][b]Greatswords:[/b][/color] Massive, hulking blades. Their special attack is a sharp plunge into the earth, creating an explosion!
[/list]
I have also modified the vanilla sword and dagger special attacks to be a touch more interesting alongside the new weapons. Swords now shoot sword beams for 2x melee damage, while daggers throw a spread of three throwing knives!Every weapon has a basic wooden, iron, and steel version purchasable from Marlon at the adventurer's guild, with 2 late-game tiers purchasable after a certain secret is found. There are also a handful of rare weapons you can only find as drops in the mine, many of them very special...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ORM7C1A.png[/img]

1: Install SMAPI, Advanced Melee Framework, and JSON Assets as well as their requirements
2: Download Stardew Valley Armaments and extract the .zip file wherever you'd like
3: Drag & Drop the StardewValleyArmaments folder into your Mods folder

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/HF6b8jx.png[/img]﻿

[/b]Should be compatible with just about anything, including mods that change combat professions like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8111]Walk of Life[/url]. Please post in the bugs section if you find any specific incompatibilities.

Downloads.Description: SVA without the changes to vanilla sword and daggers. Only install one file, this or the main (with the changes).
